verdict.rationale: Rippling exposes a versioned REST API with bearer-token auth, pagination, and search/filter capabilities (rippling-it-docs-14/15/16/17/21/22/28), which supports headless/programmatic automation of IT tasks outside the UI. However there is no explicit CLI, SDK, or CI/CD pipeline example, nor any documentation framing usage 'in CI' specifically. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI or CI integration guide, explicit CI/CD examples, and independent confirmation of headless automation workflows.
